_ebro: Through Álava and Navarra the Ebro's ways carry Spanish / Basque names ("Río Ebro / Ebro Ibaia").
_rivers: The Ebro and the seven Rioja valleys that run north from the Sierra de la Demanda / Cameros (Oja-Tirón, Najerilla, Iregua, Leza, Jubera, Cidacos, Alhama). Ega and Zadorra are left out: outside the lesson.
